content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Persons of ability, integrity and standing who have an adequate experience and capacity in dealing with the management of Water Resources; Or experts in the fields of Water Resources Engineering, Environment, Agriculture, Law, Finance, Management, Administration or Economics Experience: Adequate experience and capacity in dealing with the management of Water Resources Age limit: Maximum 65 years Other conditions: Members of the Authority shall not hold any other office during their tenure as Members

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for WRD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A person who has attained the age of sixty five years shall not serve as Member

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Retired Chief Justice, High Court Judge or Government officer: emoluments equal to last pay drawn + DA minus pension + DA; last pay may be notionally fixed if retired before general pay revision. Term as may be specified, not exceeding three years at a time from the date of entering office Term of three years may be extended up to five years depending on quality of performance, management of affairs and initiatives taken No earned leave; 20 casual leaves only; no other kind of leave admissible No pension or pensionary benefits for service rendered in the Authority No Leave Encashment and no Leave Travel Concession facility
